    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    accepted_call_ids = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        gain = call['loss_without_call'] - call['loss_with_call']
        tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        normalized_gain = gain / tokens
        if call['parseable'] and normalized_gain >= threshold:
            accepted = True
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
        else:
            accepted = False
        diagnostics.append({
            'accepted': accepted,
            'call_id': call_id,
            'normalized_gain': normalized_gain
        })
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted_call_ids, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"}
